changes.evidence: His DGSE service (and the French Foreign Legion before it) is backstory. In Captain America: The Winter Soldier, Rumlow only reads it from his file ('Ex-DGSE, Action Division'). By then Batroc is a freelance mercenary and pirate hired to take the Lemurian Star. He joins LAF after Sharon Carter frees him (The Falcon and the Winter Soldier).

Savin is a FORMER U.S. Army lieutenant colonel. He was recruited as a veteran for Extremis before the film, and throughout Iron Man 3 he works only as Killian's A.I.M. lieutenant. No Army service is shown in the film.

Brandt is a U.S. Army veteran and amputee who lost her arm before the film. Killian recruits her for Extremis, and in Iron Man 3 she works only as an A.I.M. agent (the Rose Hill fight). No Army service is shown in the film.

options: Keep as is (Children of Thanos remains the last stage)
Add ["Independent", "Avengers: Endgame"] for his retirement on the Garden
owner_calls.evidence: Wiki: 'Thanos continued with his life in retirement on the Garden... only wanted to spend his remaining days in peace' (Endgame). 2014 Thanos then brings his army and the Black Order to the Battle of Earth.
